crossRefs.note: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
crossRefs.keyword: I eat. Heb. my meat. my roarings

crossRefs.note: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
crossRefs.keyword: I eat. Heb. my meat. my roarings

crossRefs.note: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
crossRefs.keyword: I eat. Heb. my meat. my roarings

crossRefs.note: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
crossRefs.keyword: I eat. Heb. my meat. my roarings

crossRefs.note: We all roar like bears and moan bitterly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none, for salvation, but it is…
crossRefs.keyword: I eat. Heb. my meat. my roarings

crossRefs.note: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
crossRefs.keyword: I eat. Heb. my meat. my roarings

translations.web: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
translations.bsb: I sigh when food is put before me, and my groans pour out like water.
translations.kjv: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
translations.asv: For my sighing cometh before I eat, And my groanings are poured out like water.
